name: Discord Notification
description: Sends a Discord webhook notification when Claude completes a task, posting to a configured channel
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Send Discord notification via webhook
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL="${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL:-}"
if [[ -z "$DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi
PROJECT=$(basename "$(pwd)")
MESSAGE="${NOTIFICATION_MESSAGE:-Task completed}"
TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
curl -s -X POST "$DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"embeds\":[{\"title\":\"Claude Code\",\"description\":\"$MESSAGE\",\"color\":5814783,\"footer\":{\"text\":\"$PROJECT\"},\"timestamp\":\"$TIMESTAMP\"}]}" >/dev/null 2>&1
exit 0
